data.descEn: The ‘My Transition Seminar’ program is open to all CAF member at any point in their career, with spouses/partners and caregivers encouraged to attend. Transition seminars are designed to assist CAF members with their transition from military to civilian life and registration is based on the release item the member is expected to be released under. Those members undergoing or expecting to undergo a non-medical release should register for Module 1A (General), while members undergoing or expecting to undergo a medical release, should register for Module 1B (Medical). Only those members wishing to attend both modules for professional development purposes, or because they are unsure of their release item, should register for both days.
